body:
I found the issue.. our own HTTPClient is creating a wrong URI, which then your endpoint creates another redirect for. This uncovered two bugs, which have never been uncovered because of the forgiveness of many endpoints it seems to me.

Should have a PR up shortly.

I still need to investigate why this has not happened earlier...

issue.title: Fix watcher HttpClient URL creation

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The http client could end up creating URLs, that did not resemble the
original one, when encoding. This fixes a couple of corner cases, where
too much or too few slashes were added to an URI.

Closes #44970

body: @spinscale did the fix make it to `7.3.1`? I am still having the same issue.
